content: React Navigation current major is v7: @react-navigation/bottom-tabs 7.18.15 and @react-navigation/native-stack 7.18.7 (npm registry Aug 2026). Requires react-native-screens ~4.26.0 and react-native-safe-area-context ~5.7.0, both bundled in Expo Go SDK 57 (bundledNativeModules.json). Pure JS packages, no version pinning needed from Expo.
